name: Roast Chicken Thighs with Tomato-Zucchini Couscous
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: In a large pot, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous and salt, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, halve, and large dice onion; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheet with the onion, along with the tomatoes.
Peel and mince garlic; sprinkle over the veggies, then drizzle with oil and season with spices. Toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides. Add chicken to the baking sheet and nestle into the veggies.
Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until veggies are tender and chicken is cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, roughly chop olives; pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add both to the pot with the couscous.
Juice lemon into the pot and stir to combine. Cover to keep warm.
Just before serving, transfer roasted veggies to the pot with the couscous and stir to combine.
To serve, divide veggie couscous and chicken thighs between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
